<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/activate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Puts a deactivated credential back into service. Its password, keys, home directory and network
rules are unchanged, so connections work again immediately.

Activating an already-active credential succeeds and changes nothing.
